# form.addTextButton

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span> <span class="api-badge api-badge--deprecated">deprecated</span></div>

Add a text button to the current form (deprecated)

```lua
form.addTextButton(line, rect, text, press)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `text` | string | yes | the displayed text |
| `press` | function | yes | the function which will be called on button press |

## Returns

The new button

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addTextButton(line, nil, "Text Button", function() end)
```
